name: Fyksesund Bridge
facts: Fyksesund Bridge, a 344‑metre suspension road marvel, boasts a 230‑metre main span that once challenged engineers, showcasing Olaf Stang’s daring design for Norway’s County Road 7.
On October 9, 1937, Crown Prince Olav inaugurated Fyksesund Bridge, linking Øystese and Ålvik, and marking a new era of connectivity across the dramatic Fyksesund fjord.

Shortly after opening, Fyksesund Bridge suffered aerodynamic instabilities that rattled its cables, prompting a 1945 retrofit that strengthened the structure and restored its reputation as a safe, reliable crossing.
